subject: Mathematics
title: Fiji Year 10 Mock Examination 2 (2026 school format) — Mathematics
instructions:
Answer ALL questions. Time allowed: 2 hours (an extra 10 minutes is allowed for reading).
Multiple-choice: click the letter of the best answer (click again to clear).
Short answers and paragraphs: type your answer in English in the box. Show working for calculations.
Your answers are saved automatically. The paper is submitted automatically when time runs out.
You may use a calculator. Round answers to 2 decimal places unless stated otherwise.
Two questions ask you to draw on the Cartesian plane — use the graph tools (point, line, curve, shading).

questions.text:

questions.model: I: 5.70 ÷ 6 = $0.95 per bottle; II: 13.50 ÷ 15 = $0.90 per bottle → Option II is the better buy (1)

A right-angled triangle has the two shorter sides 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the length of the hypotenuse.
Prove that a triangle with sides 7 cm, 24 cm and 25 cm is a right-angled triangle.
questions.model: 7² + 24² = 49 + 576 = 625 (1) = 25². The square of the longest side equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides, so by (the converse of) Pythagoras' theorem it is right-angled (1).
